c: Chill belly hard (−2 °C, 1 h); slice 7 mm thick, 3 cm wide.
Fold each slice in half and thread tightly, 4 pieces per skewer; negi between optional.
Season with salt and pepper; grill medium-high 8–10 min, turning; move away from flare-ups; core 70 °C.
Serve with karashi and a lemon wedge.

23476028.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 120 g cooked fish + 1 hajikami
c: Boil sake and mirin 20 s to cook off the alcohol.
Off the heat whisk in sugar until dissolved, then miso until smooth; cool.
Cut 10 × 130 g portions; salt lightly 30 min; pat dry.
Coat with marinade, wrap, marinate 48–72 h at 0–4 °C.
Wipe off ALL marinade (it burns); grill skin-side down over medium binchotan 5–6 min, turn, 3–4 min (or 220 °C oven/salamander).
Look for caramelised dark spots and flakes that just separate; core 60 °C.
23476028.st: Marinated fish: 0–4 °C, max 72 h. Marinade: 0–4 °C, 2 weeks (single use with fish).
23476028.al: 4 Fish (black cod) · 6 Soybeans (white miso). Barley miso adds 1 Gluten; check sake and mirin labels for 14 Sulphites.

a36afb69.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 2 skewers ≈ 145 g with shishito
c: Cut beef into 3 cm cubes (≈ 25 g); 3 per skewer. Skewer shishito separately.
Temper 20 min out of the fridge; brush very lightly with oil; salt just before grilling.
Grill on the hottest zone (hand test 2 s) 1–1.5 min per side; core 52–55 °C (medium-rare); rest 2 min.
Grill shishito 2 min until blistered; salt.
Serve with yuzu kosho and freshly grated wasabi (grate to order on a sharkskin grater).
a36afb69.st: Raw beef skewers: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Grated wasabi loses flavour in 15 min: grate to order.

c: Trim fat lumps; blanch skin 1 min in boiling water with sake; chill flat (it tightens and is easier to thread).
Cut 4 cm strips; thread in tight S-folds (accordion), 60 g per skewer.
Grill over medium-low binchotan 12–15 min, turning often; let the fat render and drip until crisp and golden; core ≥ 75 °C.
Salt during the last minute; serve with lemon and shichimi.
a591c365.st: Blanched skin: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Threaded skewers: 0–4 °C, 24 h.
a591c365.al: 11 Sesame (shichimi togarashi). Check sake label for 14 Sulphites. Tare version: glaze 2× with yakitori tare (1 Gluten, 6 Soybeans).

f5db5a45.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 1 cob in 3 pieces ≈ 220 g
c: Beat soft butter with miso, mirin and soy until smooth; roll in film; keep 0–4 °C.
Blanch cobs 4 min in salted boiling water; cut each into 3.
Grill over medium-high binchotan 6–8 min, turning, until charred in spots.
Brush with miso butter for the last 2 min; let it bubble, not burn.
Finish with more miso butter, sliced spring onion and shichimi.
f5db5a45.st: Blanched corn: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Miso butter: 0–4 °C, 2 weeks.
f5db5a45.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (white miso, soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter) · 11 Sesame (shichimi togarashi)

43672262.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 skewers ≈ 130 g + 20 g ponzu
c: Mix everything; rest 24 h at 0–4 °C; strain. (Classic ponzu uses katsuo-bushi dashi: 4 Fish.)
Trim shiitake stems and score caps; peel lower asparagus, cut 4 cm; skewer each vegetable separately.
Grill medium-high: shishito 2 min, asparagus 3–4 min, shiitake 4–5 min (gills up first so juices stay in).
Brush shiitake with ponzu at the end; sprinkle toasted sesame; ponzu on the side.
43672262.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Vegan.

579c3ddd.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 200 g (110 g fish)
c: Blend tuna trim, ginger, garlic, chilli, coriander stems and ice 30 s.
Add lime, soy, yuzu and mirin; pulse 5 s; strain; whisk in sesame oil. Keep 0–2 °C, same day.
Dice tuna 2 cm, avocado and cucumber 1.5 cm; keep 0–2 °C.
Per portion: salt tuna, toss with leche 30–60 s only (tuna greys fast).
Fold in avocado, cucumber, thin red onion.
Finish with spring onion, toasted sesame and toasted nori strips; serve at once.
579c3ddd.st: Tuna: 0–2 °C, 24 h (frozen −20 °C ≥ 24 h before, unless supplier certifies). Mix to order only.
579c3ddd.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil, sesame seeds). Gluten-free option: tamari.

c: Slice onion thin; soak in iced water 10 min; drain.
Mix with lime, chilli, coriander, oil and salt 10 min before service.
Cut fish into 3 cm pieces; marinate with soy, grated ginger and garlic 15 min (Nikkei touch).
Toss in starch + flour; shake off excess; rest 5 min so the coating hydrates.
Fry at 175 °C 3 min until crisp; drain; salt; core 63 °C.
Serve hot with salsa criolla, ají mayo and lime.
7a11c4d9.st: Marinated fish: 0–2 °C, same day. Mayo: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Fry to order.
7a11c4d9.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (white fish fillet) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce)

c: Mix soy, sake, grated ginger, garlic and ají paste.
Cut thigh into 40 g pieces; marinate 30 min–2 h at 0–4 °C; drain.
Coat in potato starch; rest 5 min.
Double fry: 160 °C 3 min, rest 3 min, then 185 °C 1 min until very crisp; core 75 °C.
Serve on shiso with ají amarillo mayo (mayo + ají) and lime.
118d45b5.st: Marinated chicken: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Fry to order.
118d45b5.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Check sake label for 14 Sulphites.

4646f8e0.yl: Yield: 10 rolls · Portion: 1 roll, 8 pieces ≈ 280 g
c: Wash rice until clear; soak 30 min, drain 15 min; cook covered 12 min on low, rest 10 min.
Fold warm vinegar, sugar and salt into the hot rice in a hangiri while fanning; cool to body temp, damp cloth.
Devein, score the belly, press straight; mix flour and ice water briefly (lumps are fine).
Dust prawns, dip, fry at 175 °C 2 min; drain.
Whisk mayo with ají, lime and soy until smooth; keep 0–4 °C.
Half nori on a filmed mat, 130 g rice, sesame, flip (uramaki); fill with 2 prawns, avocado, cucumber; roll tight.
Lay 40 g thin-sliced tuna over the top; torch 3–5 s (aburi, optional).
Cut 8 with a wet knife; pipe acevichado sauce; serve within 15 min.
4646f8e0.st: Sushi rice: room temp, max 4 h. Sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h.
4646f8e0.al: 1 Gluten (tempura flour, soy sauce) · 2 Crustaceans (shrimp) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds)

c: Freeze 48 h and thaw at 0–4 °C; dip 3 times in boiling water; simmer 50–60 min to core ≥ 63 °C; cool in the liquid.
Slice tentacles very thin (2 mm) on the bias; chill.
Blend olives with lime and soy; fold into mayo until smooth and violet-grey; keep 0–4 °C.
Overlap 100 g octopus slices on a cold plate like carpaccio.
Coat with 30 g olive sauce; finish with olive slivers, spring onion and a few drops of olive oil.
01f0bfb1.st: Cooked octopus: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Sauce: 0–4 °C, 72 h. Plate to order.
01f0bfb1.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 12 Molluscs (octopus). Classic Nikkei dish; often served with crackers or crostini (1 Gluten).

05398274.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 245 g (130 g octopus)
c: Freeze 48 h and thaw at 0–4 °C to tenderise; remove beak and eyes.
Dip 3 times into boiling water, then simmer gently 50–60 min until a knife slides in (or sous-vide 77 °C, 5 h).
Cool in the liquid; cut tentacles into 6 cm pieces.
Whisk all until smooth; warm gently 2 min.
Blend olives into the mayo (Peruvian 'olivo' sauce).
Boil baby potatoes, crush lightly, grill until crisp.
Grill octopus very hot 2 min per side until charred; brush with glaze for the last minute (sugar burns).
Plate potatoes, octopus, dots of olive mayo, spring onion and lime.
05398274.st: Cooked octopus: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Glaze: 0–4 °C, 2 weeks. Olive mayo: 0–4 °C, 72 h.
05398274.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 6 Soybeans (white miso, soy sauce) · 12 Molluscs (octopus). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

04b108ae.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 135 g (80 g tuna)
c: Blend until very smooth; pass; piping bag, film on the surface; same day.
Slice 1 mm; start in cold oil, heat to 150 °C, stir 10–12 min until golden; drain; salt.
Trim tuna into 4 × 4 cm logs (saku); season with salt and shichimi.
Sear on the hottest binchotan or torch 15–20 s per side (2 mm cooked ring); chill 10 min.
Slice 8 mm; 80 g per plate with dots of avocado cream, ponzu around, crispy shallot, micro herbs.
04b108ae.st: Seared tuna logs: 0–2 °C, same day. Ponzu: 0–4 °C, 1 month. Shallots: airtight, 3 days.
04b108ae.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (shichimi togarashi)

c: Whisk eggs gently without foam; mix in cold dashi, usukuchi, mirin and salt (ratio 1 egg : 3 dashi).
Strain twice through a fine sieve; skim bubbles.
Simmer dashi, ají and mirin; thicken with starch slaked in water to a light gin (ankake).
Put 20 g crab and 10 g choclo in each cup; pour 115 g custard; cover with film or lid.
Steam at 85 °C (gentle) 12–15 min until just set and wobbly; core 75 °C.
Spoon 10 g warm ají glaze on top; chives; serve hot.
c8f9b3c6.st: Custard base: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Steam to order.
c8f9b3c6.al: 1 Gluten (usukuchi soy sauce) · 2 Crustaceans (crab meat) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 4 Fish (dashi) · 6 Soybeans (usukuchi soy sauce)

c: Cook and season as sushi rice; press 1.5 cm thick in a film-lined tray.
Dice tuna 5 mm; mix with the rest just before service; keep 0–2 °C.
Fry rice bars at 180 °C 2–3 min until golden and crisp; drain.
Top each with 13 g spicy tuna, a thin jalapeño slice and a micro herb; sesame.
Serve within 5 min, while the rice is crisp.
da02e015.st: Pressed rice: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Spicy tuna: mix to order.
da02e015.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 3 Eggs (mayonnaise) · 4 Fish (tuna loin) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (toasted sesame oil, sesame seeds)

3343127d.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 220 g (shared rice course)
c: Whisk ají paste into cold dashi with usukuchi, mirin and salt.
Wash rice; soak 30 min; drain 15 min. Put rice and dashi in the donabe; choclo on top.
Lid on: high heat until steam escapes (≈ 10 min), then low 12 min; last 1 min high to form the okoge crust.
Off the heat 10 min; add crab and butter, lid on 2 min.
Open at the table; fold gently, keeping crust pieces; coriander and lime.
3343127d.st: Dashi: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Cook to order; rice not held over 1 h.
3343127d.al: 1 Gluten (usukuchi soy sauce) · 2 Crustaceans (crab meat) · 4 Fish (dashi) · 6 Soybeans (usukuchi soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

42d6304c.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 130 g (80 g fish)
c: Blend trim, ginger, lemongrass, chilli, coriander and salt with the coconut milk 30 s.
Add lime, pulse 5 s; strain fine; keep 0–2 °C, same day.
Warm oil to 60 °C with zest and coriander; blend 1 min; steep 1 h; strain through a coffee filter.
Fish frozen −20 °C ≥ 24 h first. Slice 5 mm against the grain; 80 g per chilled bowl; salt flakes.
Brunoise mango, cucumber and red onion 3 mm; spoon around the fish.
Pour 20 g leche at the table; finish with drops of lime oil and micro herbs.
42d6304c.st: Sliced fish: to order. Leche: same day. Lime oil: 0–4 °C, 1 week.

2b3eeae4.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 165 g (starter or vegan main)
c: Whisk all in a pan over low heat 5 min until glossy; do not boil hard.
Halve lengthwise; score the flesh crosshatch; brush with oil.
Grill flesh-down on medium 6–8 min, then skin-down 6–8 min until completely soft.
Spread 20 g miso; caramelise flesh-up over high heat or with a torch.
Finish with sesame, spring onion and micro herbs.
2b3eeae4.st: Dengaku miso: 0–4 °C, 2 weeks. Grill to order.
2b3eeae4.al: 6 Soybeans (white miso) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Vegan. Check sake and mirin labels for 14 Sulphites.

5335d496.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 oysters ≈ 75 g meat + garnish
c: Blend 20 s, strain fine; keep 0–2 °C, same day.
Blend, strain; freeze in a flat tray, scrape with a fork every 30 min (3 times).
Shuck to order, keep the liquor; loosen the muscle, check for shell.
Set 3 oysters on crushed ice; 5 g leche each.
Top with 1 tsp granita, tiny rocoto brunoise and shiso cress; serve at once.
5335d496.st: Live oysters: 2–6 °C, cup-side down, damp cloth, max 5 days. Shuck to order only.

2a1d376c.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 215 g (120 g duck cooked)
c: Roast whole at 190 °C 50–60 min; scoop out; blend with warm cream, butter, lime, salt; pass; hold 65 °C.
Slice daikon 1.5 mm; boil vinegar, water, sugar and salt; pour over hot; chill 2 h.
Score the skin 5 mm crosshatch; salt 1 h ahead; render skin-down from a cold pan, medium heat 8–10 min.
Finish on the medium robata zone 4–5 min, glazing the last 2 min; core 57 °C; rest 6 min.
Slice; plate on camote purée with pickled daikon and spring onion.
2a1d376c.st: Glaze: 0–4 °C, 2 weeks. Purée: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Daikon: 0–4 °C, 1 week.
2a1d376c.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (white miso, soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

50eea330.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 220 g (140 g fish)
c: Cook butter to noisette (nutty, 150 °C); cool 2 min.
Whisk in soy, mirin, yuzu and lime (it foams); hold 50 °C, whisk before use.
Portion 150 g; score the skin; salt 15 min; pat dry; oil lightly.
Grill skin-down on an oiled rack, medium-high 4–5 min until crisp; turn 1–2 min; core 58 °C.
Halve pak choi; grill cut side 2 min until charred, stems still crisp; salt.
Plate fish skin up on pak choi; 24 g warm brown butter ponzu around; sesame, chives.
50eea330.st: Fish: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Ponzu butter: per service.
50eea330.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (job fish fillet) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

df3a1a1b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 180 g (starter or vegan main)
c: Warm coconut oil; whisk in miso, mirin and grated garlic; keep liquid at 30 °C.
Steep shiitake in kombu dashi at 60 °C for 30 min; strain; season with usukuchi and mirin.
Halve mushrooms lengthwise; score the cut side deeply in a crosshatch (scallop look).
Grill cut side down on medium 4 min, turn 3 min; brush with miso butter; 1 min more.
Pour 50 g hot dashi into a warm bowl; mushrooms on top; spring onion, sesame, micro herbs.
df3a1a1b.al: 1 Gluten (usukuchi soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (white miso, usukuchi soy sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame seeds). Vegan. Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

1c955286.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: 3 cutlets ≈ 210 g bone-in + garnish
c: Chop herbs fine by knife; mix with ají, garlic, vinegar, lime, oil and salt. Make 1 h before service.
Brush cutlets with miso thinned with mirin; marinate 1 h at 0–4 °C. Wrap the bones in foil.
Grill on high binchotan 2 min per side, fat edge last; core 55–58 °C; rest 3 min.
Plate 3 cutlets with shishito and 30 g salsa; salt flakes.
1c955286.st: Marinated lamb: 0–4 °C, 24 h. Salsa: 0–4 °C, same day.
1c955286.al: 6 Soybeans (white miso). Check mirin label for 14 Sulphites.

cdb7371b.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ½ poussin ≈ 230 g bone-in + garnish
c: Reduce stock with sake, mirin and soy to 400 g (light coating).
Mount with cold butter; finish with yuzu kosho off the heat.
Spatchcock 5 poussins (≈ 520 g); rub with shio koji (8% of weight); marinate 12–24 h at 0–4 °C.
Wipe off excess koji (it burns); grill skin-up on medium 12 min, then skin-down 6–8 min, moving to avoid flare-ups.
Core 75 °C at the thigh; rest 5 min; cut in halves.
Grill negi until soft; plate with poussin, 32 g jus and lemon.
cdb7371b.st: Koji-marinated poussin: 0–4 °C, max 24 h. Jus: 0–4 °C, 72 h.
cdb7371b.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 7 Milk (butter) · 9 Celery (chicken stock). Check sake and mirin labels for 14 Sulphites.

ce045dec.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 240 g in a bowl (120 g fish)
c: Sweat onion, garlic and ginger in oil 5 min; add ají paste 2 min, tomato 3 min.
Deglaze with sake; add stock; simmer 15 min; strain.
Season at service with soy and lime; add coriander.
Score the skin; salt 10 min; pat dry.
Grill skin-down on an oiled hot rack 3–4 min until crisp; turn 1 min; core 58–60 °C.
Per portion heat 100 g broth with 60 g clams, covered, until they open (discard closed ones).
Warm bowl: broth and clams, fish skin up, sea herbs.
ce045dec.st: Broth: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Clams: live, 2–4 °C, damp cloth, 48 h. Fish: 0–2 °C, 24 h.
ce045dec.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 4 Fish (fish stock, red snapper fillet) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce) · 12 Molluscs (clams). Check sake label for 14 Sulphites.

3d9791e4.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 230 g (110 g lobster)
c: Simmer kernels in milk and cream 10 min; blend 3 min; pass through a fine sieve.
Finish with butter and salt; hold 65 °C.
Reduce sake, vinegar and shallot to 30 g; add cream, 1 min.
Off the heat whisk in cold butter cubes, keep 60–65 °C; strain.
Finish with yuzu juice and yuzu kosho; hold 60 °C, max 2 h.
Skewer each tail straight on 2 metal skewers; brush with butter; salt.
Grill on high binchotan 2–3 min per side; core 60 °C; rest 1 min; slice into medallions.
Char corn cobs, cut the kernels off in strips.
Plate: swipe of purée, lobster, charred corn, 30 g beurre blanc, chives.
3d9791e4.st: Raw tails: 0–2 °C, 24 h. Purée: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Beurre blanc: make per service.
3d9791e4.al: 2 Crustaceans (spiny lobster tail meat) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, cream 33%, butter). Check sake label for 14 Sulphites.

c: Blend all 30 s; strain fine; keep 0–2 °C, same day.
Pulse to a coarse crumb; mix with zest and salt; keep airtight.
Remove the side muscle; slice each scallop horizontally into 3 discs; keep 0–2 °C.
Fan 9 discs in a chilled shallow bowl; season with salt flakes.
Pour 20 g leche at the pass; finish with cancha crumb, chilli and micro coriander.
5b4c33b9.st: Scallops: 0–2 °C, 24 h, slice to order. Leche: same day. Crumb: airtight, 5 days.

bc069b45.yl: Yield: 10 portions · Portion: ≈ 165 g (100 g beef cooked)
c: Boil sake and mirin 1 min; add soy and sugar.
Blend with black garlic; simmer 5 min to coating consistency; strain.
Grill whole on binchotan until black outside, 10–12 min.
Wrap in foil 10 min to steam; peel the burnt layer; cut 5 cm; dress with oil and salt.
Temper 30 min; salt just before grilling.
Grill on a raised rack over high heat (Wagyu fat flares), turning every 30 s, 5–6 min; core 54 °C; rest 4 min.
Slice 1 cm; brush with tare; plate with negi, sansho, salt flakes and freshly grated wasabi.
bc069b45.st: Tare: 0–4 °C, 1 month. Negi: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Beef: 0–4 °C, cut to order.
bc069b45.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce). Check sake and mirin labels for 14 Sulphites.
